about: Known gaps of the no-TeX-Live gate (tools/bundle/texbundle.py gate, notex-gate.yml): documents whose PDF from the bundle may differ from TeX Live's pdflatex for a reason another lane owns. kind: metafont (a font TeX Live makes with METAFONT at run time, mktextfm/mktexpk, which a bundle cannot carry), eps (EPS figures converted by epstopdf/Ghostscript through \write18, absent without TeX Live). Remove an entry when its lane lands; the gate lists entries that have become identical.
